name: yoho-cli
description: Manage PageHush articles and install, update, or remove Codeup Agent Skills

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md README.zh-CN.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md README.zh-CN.md
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/cli/*.test.mjs tests/remote/*.test.mjs tests/skills/*.test.mjs
